exposure: 200 mcg vaginal misoprostol every 4 h until the abortion
misoprostol as in International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics's (FIGO) 2012 recommendation
cohort: 263 patients undergoing pregnancy terminations with misoprostol between 12 and 24 weeks gestation
finding: There was no significant difference in time to abortion, total misoprostol dose, or complication rates between the two misoprostol regimens for mid-trimester pregnancy termination.
